item.title: The Conqueror Recalls Avengers Medals Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Magnet Ingestion; Violate Mandatory Standard for Magnets
item.company: Sold Online At: www.theconqueror.events and through The Conqueror App from March 2026 through May 2026 for about $50.
item.brand: Sold Online At: www.theconqueror.events and through The Conqueror App from March 2026 through May 2026 for about $50.
item.summary: This recall involves the Avengers Infinity Gauntlet medal. The medal is gold, with colorful gems on the front and comes in a black package marked “Marvel Avengers” with Marvel Avengers artwork. The medals are part of the Avengers virtual challenge series. To receive the medal, customers must have completed the Infinity Gauntlet virtual challenge on the Conqueror App.
item.affectedPeople: Consumers who purchased: Avengers Infinity Gauntlet Medals.
item.remedy: Consumers should stop using the Avengers Infinity Gauntlet Medal immediately and contact The Conqueror for instructions on receiving a full refund or a replacement medal. Consumers will be asked to cut the ribbon from the medal and write “RECALLED” in permanent marker on the medal and ribbon, throw the product away and email a photo of the disposed medal and ribbon to support@theconqueror.events.
item.payoutAmount: Repair, refund, replacement, or other remedy if stated by the CPSC notice
